verdicts.reason: A reads left to right in a sensible order: quote mark, the quote on one line, the attribution, then the product. But the quote is set so small it is barely legible at 320x50, and the Solstice logo is a faint smudge sitting on the grey circle at the far left. B splits the quote into four cramped lines jammed against the left edge, puts the opening quote mark after the quote it opens, and shrinks the logo to an unreadable speck on the far right. That leaves B's reading order jumbled and its spacing lopsided.
